_doc: #147: what each person of the cast is to the learner and to each other, read by cast_registry (member.relation_to_learner, member.relations, person().relation). Facts only from docs/story/season-1/00-season-bible.md and world.json, cited per row. `kind` is what a surface tests (is this a friend? is this family?); the labels are what a surface may print, per interface language. `known_from` is the (tentpole, day) of the page that first tells the learner, so a Courrier does not spoil a tie the story has not shown. A person outside this file is outside the cast: a one-letter extra has no relation and no row here.

kinds.friend: a friend, or becoming one: may be called so
kinds.regular: a regular at Le Mistral who has not earned the word friend
kinds.host: keeps the place the learner comes to
kinds.other_side: on the other side of the sale: never a friend in season 1
kinds.professional: someone doing their job for the learner
